name: Radio
purpose: Selects exactly one option from a set of mutually exclusive choices.
scenarios: Pick a preferred language in a group

options.description: Array of radio options with value and label.

label.description: Accessible label for the radio group.

name.description: Name shared by the native radio inputs.

antiPatterns: Do not use a radio group for boolean choices; use a checkbox or switch.
Do not remove the group label.

keyboard: Arrow keys move selection within the group
a11y.focus: Visible focus indicator on the selected radio; roving tabindex is handled by the primitive.
a11y.labeling: Group label is associated with the radiogroup; each option is labelled by its text.

responsive.strategy: Options stack vertically; on wide screens they may be arranged horizontally by a parent layout.

breakpoints.compact: Touch targets remain at least 44px high; options stack vertically.
breakpoints.large: Options may be arranged horizontally by a parent layout.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Options follow the document direction; arrow-key order is handled by the primitive.
